id: title:Gilbert09:show egress ips on the database source form

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a conditional UI component for DatabaseFirewallHint, potentially displaying firewall allowlisting instructions to warehouse users, but lacks backend implementation and connector metadata.
review.reason: The change is a narrow, frontend-only addition of a conditional rendering for DatabaseFirewallHint. While it could eventually support warehouse users, the absence of backend provisioning and connector metadata prevents assigning a higher tier. This aligns with Tier 1: a localized, bounded change without demonstrated systemic benefit or backend support.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit and implementation status depend on unverified backend and metadata support not present in this chunk.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a frontend-only change. No backend implementation, configuration, or test assertions are supplied. The hunk P1.F1.H3 adds a conditional rendering of DatabaseFirewallHint, but the connector category and the backend provisioning of egress IPs are not shown. No tier can be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional import and a new DatabaseFirewallHint component, then mounts it when selectedConnector.category === 'Databases'.
observations.posthog_connection: Could display firewall allowlisting instructions to warehouse users, but the backend provisioning and connector metadata are not shown.
